name: lemma
description: Lemma's own plugins. Telepath connects your existing Telegram conversations to Claude over a hosted MCP server.

plugins.name: lemma-telepath
plugins.description: Your existing Telegram, readable by Claude: search the archive, read the documents, photos and transcribed voice inside it, and reply as yourself. Two things make it work, both free: connect the bundled Telepath connector, and add @lemma_telepath_bot in Telegram under Settings → My Account → Chat automation. Works on every account — no Premium.
